claim:monod_kinetics.proposition: Field-only baseline: Monod uptake/growth on a well-mixed substrate pool (no spatial lattice, no particles). Use to sanity-check kinetics + mass balance.

claim:ecoli_core_dfba.proposition: Single-cell metabolism baseline: dynamic FBA for E. coli core with external glucose/acetate and biomass over time (no space, no particles).

claim:ecoli_dfba.proposition: Single-cell metabolism (large model): dynamic FBA using iAF1260 with tracked extracellular fields (glucose/formate) and biomass. Stress-tests solver + exchange wiring.

claim:yeast_dfba.proposition: Single-cell metabolism (yeast): dynamic FBA using iMM904 with extracellular glucose and biomass. Cross-model check of the dFBA pipeline.

claim:diffusion_process.proposition: Field transport primitive: finite-volume diffusion/advection on a 2D lattice. Use to validate boundary conditions, stability, and transport timescales.

claim:brownian_particles.proposition: Particle-only baseline: Brownian motion of agents with mass in continuous space (no fields, no metabolism). Checks integrator + particle state schema.

claim:newtonian_particles.proposition: Physics-only baseline (Pymunk): rigid-body particles with collisions/crowding in continuous space. Use to validate contact dynamics + boundary enforcement.

claim:community_dfba.proposition: Multi-agent well-mixed community: several independent dFBA instances share the same extracellular pools, creating competition / cross-feeding dynamics without space.

claim:dfba_kinetics_community.proposition: Hybrid community (well-mixed): mixes Monod-kinetic agents with dFBA agents in a shared environment. Demonstrates heterogeneous process composition under one schema.

claim:spatial_many_dfba.proposition: Spatial microenvironment (sitewise dFBA): a lattice where each site runs its own dFBA instance. Useful for validating lattice indexing + per-site state isolation.

claim:spatial_dfba_process.proposition: Spatial microenvironment (vectorized dFBA): one spatial dFBA process updates all lattice sites as a single structured state. Demonstrates batched execution + field coupling.

claim:comets_diffusion.proposition: Two-phase coupling (no particles): spatial dFBA on a lattice with advection–diffusion of substrates + biomass. The classic COMETS field-only scenario.

claim:br_particles_kinetics.proposition: Particle–field coupling (kinetics): Brownian agents sample local lattice concentrations and apply Monod-style exchange, modifying both particle mass and fields.

claim:br_particles_dfba.proposition: Particle-embedded metabolism: Brownian agents carry internal dFBA; uptake/secretion couples to fields and biomass accumulates into particle mass/size.

claim:comets_br_particles_kinetics.proposition: Three-way coupling: spatial dFBA fields + Brownian particle agents that run Monod kinetics locally + diffusion. End-to-end smoke test of the COMETS-style composite stack with kinetic agents.

claim:comets_br_particles_dfba.proposition: Full COMETS-style spatial composite: lattice dFBA + advection–diffusion + Brownian particles with internal dFBA + division. End-to-end coupled scenario.

claim:comets_nt_particles_dfba.proposition: Mechanochemical + metabolic coupling: Pymunk particles move/collide while COMETS fields diffuse; particles run metabolism (via exchange) against local concentrations.

claim:spatioflux_reference_demo.proposition: SpatioFlux demonstration reference composite: Newtonian motile particles + particle–field exchange + internal multi-dFBA + Monod/diffusion fields + mass-aggregated division.

claim:reference_demo_x2y2.proposition: Different resolution for the spatio-flux reference demo
